senses.sense_definition: Decorated with small holes or dots.

examples.text: The antique silver tray was beautifully <w>pounced</w> with intricate patterns.

examples.text: Artisans often <w>pounced</w> leather to create delicate textures.

target_lang_translations.nl: Ambachtslieden hebben leer vaak <w>geperforeerd</w> om verfijnde texturen te creëren.
